notes.title: Menu Update 1/21/2022
notes.notes:
This is our first feature update so that is exciting! After talking with some of the users I have prioritized updating the menu system to make it a bit more user friendly. This update included a few other things as well. The full list of changes is as follows:


Updated the pause menu.
Updated the textures for text to be easier to read.
Added the Game of Life item to the objects category.

notes.title: Release Date Finalized
notes.notes: After finalizing some last minute updates and getting our approval from Steam we are ready to release on September 15th. I'll be setting up a discord server to receive feedback from everyone who tries out MyHoriZen and I look forward to hearing from you! Thank you to everyone who has supported this project!
